RAINFALL.leakage_risk: Critical if used as feature on day t. Allowed only as strictly past lags (t-1, t-2, etc.).

REFERENCE_RAINFALL.leakage_risk: Reanalysis data. In real-time forecast operations, Numerical Weather Prediction (NWP) forecast (e.g. ECMWF IFS or IMD GFS) replaces ERA5-Land.

TEMPERATURE.leakage_risk: Available concurrently in NWP forecasts; in historical reanalysis it represents daily mean.

HUMIDITY.leakage_risk: Available in NWP forecasts; crucial for atmospheric moisture content.

WIND.leakage_risk: Available in NWP forecasts; captures convective transport.

ET.leakage_risk: ET is computed from cumulative daily surface energy balance. While daily integrated ET is an analysis/diagnostic variable, forecasted ET or potential ET is routinely produced by NWP models. Must be tested for incremental utility.

ELEVATION.leakage_risk: No temporal leakage. Spatially fixed per Panchayat.

GPCODE.leakage_risk: High risk if treated as continuous numerical feature (would memorize spatial IDs). Must be treated as categorical or strictly used for grouping.
